integrity.claim_scope: all n>=2 and nonempty center subsets; full integral homology persistence
integrity.computational_support: direct boundary-column reductions over three prime fields for n=2..8 and literal order complexes for n=2..5; finite evidence is not an unrestricted proof
integrity.external_material: only cited statements and bibliographic links; no third-party full-paper reproduction

limitations: Exact only for the centered furtherness filtration of nonempty Boolean subset posets; does not assert homotopy types at each filtration level, other poset families, or an equivariant integral splitting.
title: Complete integral furtherness barcodes of Boolean subset posets
